notes: All module interfaces are frozen as listed. Cross-module signals use identical names and widths. Top-level dbg_features is hardwired to 3'b111 for L3. Epoch/flush signals originate from ROB and are forwarded via fetch_unit and LSU to caches. dbg_ooo_issue from issue_queue, dbg_ooo_bypass from ROB with dmem_waiting input from LSU.
